study: Contract value, conditional dual prices, activity cancellation, and SOC protection
design_status: Fixed before the study runs; correctness probes are not study results
scope: Exact-scenario, one-person mechanism experiments plus reruns of the published-profile adaptation and the existing analytical benchmark. Not full-manuscript or empirical acceptance validation.
units: Authored JPY-equivalent utility, lambda_money=1; do not combine with Bryan CHF

comparison.A: Reference fixed-integer LP multiplier extrapolation of signed compensation
comparison.B: Same gym choice fixed; all continuous decisions reoptimized
comparison.C: Gym participation and continuous decisions reoptimized jointly
independent_references: two separately formulated route LPs without binary/big-M rows

contract.guarantee_scope: arrival and post-dispatch states of eligible activities; appointment guarantee also applies to nominal plan

authored_inputs.information: One common planned work duration, gym choice, precharge connection offset and duration; fixed nominal order work-appointment-gym-home, removing absent/skipped activities. No waiting, insertion, activity reselection, or charging adjustment after realization. The all-activities nominal plan remains physically feasible even at probability endpoints.

validity_rules.infeasible: Retain status=2 and null compensation; never replace by zero or an arbitrary penalty
validity_rules.other_solver_status: Retain raw record, fail execution gate, and withhold dependent claims
validity_rules.acceptance: Model indifference condition R >= max(0,C), with explicit tie convention; not observed acceptance
validity_rules.repetitions: All supported states enumerated exactly; no Monte Carlo seeds or confidence intervals. Grid cells are designed conditions, not sampled people.
validity_rules.external_validity: UNOBSERVED; no Fukushima activity records or contract acceptance observations used
